([[Duncanville, Texas]]) | college = * [[Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball|Texas Tech]] (2020–2021) * [[TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball|TCU]] (2021–2024) * [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown]] (2024–2025) | draft_year = 2025 | draft_round = 2 | draft_pick = 40 | draft_team = [[Washington Wizards]] | career_start = 2025 | years1 = {{nbay|2025|start}}–present | team1 = [[New Orleans Pelicans]] | highlights = * First-team [[List of All-Big East Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big East]] (2025) }} '''Micah James Peavy''' (born July 16, 2001) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[New Orleans Pelicans]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball|Texas Tech Red Raiders]], [[TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball|TCU Horned Frogs]], and [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown Hoyas]], and was drafted 40th overall by the [[Washington Wizards]] in the [[2025 NBA draft]]. ==Early life and high school career== Peavy attended [[Dekaney High School]] in [[Houston|Houston, Texas]] for his freshman and sophomore years and [[Duncanville High School]] in [[Duncanville, Texas]] for his junior and senior years. As a senior, he averaged 19 points and 7.5 rebounds per game and was named the TABC Class 6A player of the year.{{cite web |last1=Davison |first1=Drew |title=This basketball transfer from Texas Tech has won everywhere. He expects the same at TCU |url=https://www.star-telegram.com/sports/college/big-12/texas-christian-university/article250670689.html |website=Fort Worth Star-Telegram |access-date=March 4, 2025}} ===Recruiting=== Coming out of high school, Peavy was rated as the 32nd overall player in the class of 2020 and committed to playing college basketball for [[Texas Tech Red Raiders men's basketball|Texas Tech]] over offers from [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]], [[TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball|TCU]], and [[Texas Longhorns men's basketball|Texas]].{{cite web career== ===Texas Tech=== As a freshman in 2020–21, Peavy made 25 starts where he averaged 5.7 points per game for Texas Tech.{{cite web |last1=Griffith |first1=Katherine |title=Ex-Texas Tech guard Micah Peavy announces transfer to TCU |url=https://www.dallasnews.com/sports/tcu-horned-frogs/2021/04/14/frogs-land-texas-tech-transfer-micah-peavy/ |website=Dallas News |access-date=March 4, 2025}} After the season, he entered his name into the [[NCAA transfer portal]].{{cite web |title=Reports: Texas Tech guard Micah Peavy to enter transfer portal |url=https://www.dallasnews.com/sports/texas-tech-red-raiders/2021/04/02/reports-texas-tech-guard-micah-peavy-to-enter-transfer-portal/ |website=Dallas News |access-date=March 4, 2025}} ===TCU=== Peavy transferred to play for the [[TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball|TCU Horned Frogs]]. In 2021–22, he appeared in 34 games with nine starts, where he averaged 6.1 points, four rebounds, 1.1 assists, and 0.6 steals per game.{{cite web |title=Micah Peavy College Stats |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/micah-peavy-1.html |website=Sports Reference |access-date=March 4, 2025}} In 2022–23, Peavy played in 30 games with eight starts and averaged seven points, 3.1 rebounds, 1.2 assists, and one steal per game. In 2023–24, he averaged 10.9 points, 4.9 rebounds, and 2.6 assists per game.{{cite web |last1=Tipton |first1=Joe |title=TCU transfer guard Micah Peavy commits to Georgetown |url=https://www.on3.com/college/georgetown-hoyas/news/tcu-transfer-guard-micah-peavy-commits-to-georgetown/ |website=On3.com |access-date=March 4, 2025}} After the season, Peavy once again entered his name into the NCAA transfer portal.{{cite web |last1=Grubbs |first1=Grant |title=Report: TCU guard Micah Peavy plans to enter NBA Draft, NCAA Transfer Portal |url=https://www.on3.com/transfer-portal/news/report-tcu-guard-micah-peavy-plans-to-enter-nba-draft-ncaa-transfer-portal/ |website=On3.com |access-date=March 4, 2025}} ===Georgetown=== Peavy transferred to play for the [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown Hoyas]]. On November 23, 2024, he totaled 24 points, six assists, and three steals in a win over [[2024–25 Saint Francis Red Flash men's basketball team|Saint Francis]].{{cite web |last1=Stevens |first1=Patrick |title=Micah Peavy helps Georgetown dial in to beat St. Francis (Pa.) |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/2024/11/23/georgetown-saint-francis-basketball-micah-peavy/ |website=The Washington Post |access-date=March 4, 2025}} On December 18, Peavy tallied 20 points, eight rebounds, eight assists, seven steals and a block in a victory over [[2024–25 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]].{{cite web |last1=Derryberry |first1=Jace |title=NBA Draft: Georgetown's Micah Peavy Shows Versatility vs. Creighton |url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/nba-draft-georgetown-micah-peavy-shows-versatility-vs-creighton |website=Sports Illustrated |access-date=March 4, 2025}} On February 8, 2025, he posted 22 points, seven rebounds, four assists, and three steals in a win over [[2024–25 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]].{{cite web |last1=Jakabcsin |first1=Ben |title=Micah’s machination: Peavy dazzles again in win over ‘Hall |url=https://georgetownvoice.com/2025/02/08/micahs-machination-peavy-dazzles-again-in-win-over-hall/ |website=The Georgetown Voice |access-date=March 4, 2025}} On February 19, Peavy put up 30 points, seven rebounds, seven assists, and six steals in a win over [[2024–25 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]].{{cite web |last1=Derryberry |first1=Jace |title=NBA Draft: Georgetown's Micah Peavy Boosts Draft Value With Recent Play |url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/nba-draft-georgetown-micah-peavy-stock-boost |work=NBA Draft on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=March 4, 2025}} On February 26, he notched 25 points, three assists and two rebounds versus [[2024–25 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|UConn]].{{cite web |last1=Ogunwale |first1=Oluwajoba |title=UConn Coach Dan Hurley Criticizes Mock Drafts for Snubbing Georgetown’s Micah Peavy |url=https://collegefootballnetwork.com/mens-college-basketball/uconn-dan-hurley-questions-mock-drafts-for-snubbing-georgetown-micah-peavy/ |website=College Football Network |access-date=March 4, 2025}} At the conclusion of the season, Peavy was named to the All-Big East First Team. He was the first Hoya to be so honored since [[Jessie Govan]] following the 2018–2019 season.{{cite web |title=Reports: Peavy Named All-BIG EAST First Team; Sorber Tabbed Third Team and Unanimous Selection to All-Freshman Team |url=https://guhoyas.com/news/2025/3/9/mens-basketball-peavy-named-all-big-east-first-team-sorber-tabbed-third-team-and-unanimous-selection-to-all-freshman-team.aspx |website=guhoyas.com |access-date=June 26, 2025}} ==Professional career== Peavy was selected with the 40th pick in the [[2025 NBA draft]] by the [[Washington Wizards]] and traded to the [[New Orleans Pelicans]].{{cite news |title=Pelicans land Georgetown’s Micah Peavy with 40th pick |url=https://www.wwltv.com/article/sports/nba/pelicans/new-orleans-selects-georgetowns-micah-peavy-at-40th-in-draft/289-1ebe973d-bf3e-4e53-8dee-b6b83fd62266 |access-date=July 5, 2025 |work=4WWL |date=June 26, 2025}} The trade to Pelicans became official on July 6, 2025.{{Cite web |title=New Orleans Pelicans complete three-team trade with Washington Wizards and Houston Rockets {{!}} New Orleans Pelicans |url=https://pelicans.com/news/jordan-poole-saddiq-bey-trade-washington-wizards-nba-free-agency-new-orleans-pelicans-roster-moves-july-6-2025 |access-date=July 6, 2025 |website=pelicans.com |language=en}} The next day, Peavy signed his rookie contract.{{cite web|title=New Orleans Pelicans sign rookie Micah Peavy|url=https://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/micah-peavy-forward-signed-new-orleans-pelicans-roster-rookie-nba-draft-2025|website=NBA.com|date=July 7, 2025|access-date=July 10, 2025}} On April 7, 2026, Peavy recorded a career-high 20 points on 9-of-13 shooting during a 156–137 victory over the [[2025–26 Utah Jazz season|Utah Jazz]].{{Cite web|title=Pelicans' Micah Peavy: Scores 20 points in
